insertionReview.rationale: Approve all three finite events/storylines with timeline start 2023. The factual sources establish the spring death/tribute storyline, summer Contest saga and late-year Gang War crossover. Approve editorial same-year order The Death of Ms. Marvel, Contest of Chaos, Gang War before the existing 2024 Fall/Rise event. This does not claim an exact in-universe total chronology, alter the supplied within-list order or classify a broad character run as an event.
